units.source_text: 但教一息尚存，决不相忘。”

en.t: So long as I still have one breath left, I will never forget you.

units.source_text: 此时那大弍夫人已在埋怨了：“你在哪儿呀？

en.t: By then the wife of the Daini was already complaining, Where are you?

units.source_text: 侍从心绪烦乱，只得匆匆上车，只管回头凝望。

en.t: The lady-in-waiting was distraught, and could only hurry into the carriage, still turning back to gaze after her.

units.source_text: 多年来，即使在忧患之时，侍从亦不离开小姐一步。

en.t: For many years, even in times of sorrow and hardship, the lady-in-waiting had never left her young mistress's side for a moment.

units.source_text: 如今匆匆别去，小姐不免感到孤寂。

en.t: Now that she was leaving in such haste, the young lady could not help feeling lonely.

units.source_text: 侍从走后，连几个不中用了的老侍女也发起牢骚来：“对啊，早该走了。

en.t: After the lady-in-waiting had gone, even the few useless old serving women began to grumble, Yes, she should have left long ago.

units.source_text: 年纪轻轻的，怎么可以长留在此呢？

en.t: How could someone so young stay here forever?

units.source_text: 我们这些老太婆也忍受不下去了！”

en.t: Even old women like us cannot endure it any longer!

units.source_text: 便各自考虑亲眷朋友，准备另找去处。

en.t: So each of them began thinking of relatives and friends, preparing to find another place to go.

units.source_text: 末摘花只得闷闷地听着。

en.t: Suetsumuhana could only listen in silence, heavy-hearted.
